http:
  routers:
    backend-dev:
      rule: "Host(`${APP_HOST}`) && (PathPrefix(`/api`) || PathPrefix(`/swagger-ui`) || PathPrefix(`/api-docs`))"
      entryPoints: [${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT}]
      service: backend-dev
    frontend-dev:
      rule: "Host(`${APP_HOST}`)"
      entryPoints: [${TRAEFIK_ENTRYPOINT}]
      service: frontend-dev
  services:
    backend-dev:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://host.docker.internal:3030"
    frontend-dev:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: "http://host.docker.internal:5173"
=== no-tls traefik ===
api:
  insecure: true

providers:
  docker:
    exposedByDefault: false
  file:
    directory: /etc/traefik/dynamic

entryPoints:
  web:
    address: ":3000"
  websecure:
    address: ":3443"

observation.command: cat /workspace/.docker/infra/traefik/dynamic/dev-services.yaml.tmpl 2>/dev/null; echo "=== no-tls traefik ==="; cat /workspace/.docker/infra/traefik/traefik-no-tls.yaml 2>/dev/null | head -40
